texts.Funders_Finder_Intro: Search open federal funding listings on Grants.gov. Only the words you search are sent. Save a listing to add it to the pipeline as a prospect.

texts.Funders_Finder_SavedToast: Saved to the pipeline as a prospect.

texts.Funders_HealthCheck_PastDeadlineDetail: These grants are still at Prospect, Letter of Inquiry or Invited to Apply, but their Application Deadline has passed. Move each to Applied if it went in, set it to Withdrawn if you did not apply, or change the deadline if the funder extended it. The first ones are linked below.
